description:
[Merchant] List the merchant's campaigns. A campaign groups placements, possibly of different products, and reports their combined results.

**Endpoint:** GET /campaigns

Changing anything here needs the PRM plan, and below it a change answers 403 ERR_UNAUTHORIZED_OPERATION; reading works on every plan, results only on PRM. A merchant that leaves PRM keeps its placements read-only, and a printed placement code then pays as its plain product with no attribution.

useSandbox.description: Use the sandbox (the default) rather than production
